newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RUGBY UNION-BEACH GAME THE KEY TO BRAZIL'S FUTURE SUCCESS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BEACH GAME THE KEY TO BRAZIL'S FUTURE SUCCESS.

text.p: The coach of Brazil's fledgling rugby union team said on Thursday he hoped beach rugby would help make the sport more popular in Latin America's largest country in the next few years.
Brazil is already a major power in beach volleyball, featured at the Olympics for the first time this year, while many major cities have beach soccer leagues.
"Anyone who plays beach rugby will certainly enjoy it and will want to have a go playing on grass," said national team coach Antonio Martoni Neto.
Martoni said a big offensive would be made to promote beach rugby during the coming Brazilian summer.
Brazil set off on Thursday to compete in their first official competition -- the qualifying tournament for the 1999 Rugby World Cup.
They face preliminary round matches against Guyana and Trinidad in a tournament to be held in the Guyana capital Georgetown. It starts on Saturday.
Martoni said the Brazilians eventually hoped their natural flair would help enrich the sport in the same way it has with soccer.
"Our players are more creative and make the sport better to watch," he said.
